      @NotNull Slot.Mutable slot(@Range(from=0L,to=2147483647L) int x, @Range(from=0L,to=2147483647L) int y)
      Description copied from interface: InventoryGrid
      Gets the slot based on the position, x and y start at 0 therefore negate 1 from how the grid is actually viewed. The X starts from the left and moves right and the Y starts from bottom and moves up, therefore the following example would be slot(1, 0) to get the Z
